Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 rgnt_num number;
 usrg_num number;
begin
 nullchk;
 check_package_failure;
 begin
 select 'x' 
 into :GLOBAL.x
 from dual 
 where exists
 (select test_kit_id from usable_reagents 
 where test_kit_id = :ctrl_blk_1.s_test_kit_id
 and test_id = :ctrl_blk_1.test_id
 and tech1_result is null 
 and qc_date is null
 and qc_user is null 
 and reagent_type = 'C' 
 and trunc(expiry_date) > trunc(sysdate) 
 and chk_out_tst > 0
 and reagent_id in 
 (select reagent_id 
 from reagent_store_mst 
 where lab_code = :global.user_testing_lab_code
 and reagent_status != 'R')
 );
 
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 show_error('2332');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 --check_package_failure;
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 begin
 select count(*)
 into usrg_num 
 from usable_reagents 
 where test_kit_id = :ctrl_blk_1.s_test_kit_id;

 select count(*) 
 into rgnt_num 
 from reagent_store_mst 
 where reagent_id in
 (select reagent_id 
 from usable_reagents 
 where test_kit_id = :ctrl_blk_1.s_test_kit_id) 
 and reagent_status not in ('Hold','R');

 if rgnt_num != usrg_num then
 show_error('1822');
 else
 query_details;
 end if;
 end;
NEXT_ITEM;
end;

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_RECORD
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
i number(5); 
row_go number(5);
 j number(5);
row_all number(5);
 BEGIN

select count(*) into row_go from usable_reagents where chapter_id = :s_chapter_id and test_id = :ctrl_blk_1.test_id
 and (qc_flag is null or(review_flag is null and qc_user != :banner.user_id)) and test_kit_id = :s_test_kit_id and
reagent_type = 'C';

 
 go_record(1);
 for j in 1..row_go loop 
 if :control_info.qc_user IS NULL then
 :control_info.qc_user := :banner.user_id;
 :control_info.qc_date := sysdate;
 
 end if;
 execute_trigger('validate_result');
 if :global.result = '0' then
 exit;
 else
 if :system.last_record = 'FALSE' then
 down;
 else
 exit;
 end if;
 end if;
 end loop;
 
 if :system.last_record = 'TRUE' and :global.result = '1' then
 :system.message_level := '25';
 commit; bell;

 if form_success
 then
 show_error('0000');
 
 go_block('ctrl_blk_1');
 else
 clear_form(full_rollback);
 execute_trigger('key-clrfrm');
 show_error('0230');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 :system.message_level := 0;
 execute_trigger('key-clrfrm');
 end if;
 

 
 





 

 END;
